execution_mode.description: "cli" if run-scenario/run-set executed the model; "manual" if the model was run outside the CLI and this record was produced by import-manual-run to curate outputs after the fact.

framework_commit.description: Git commit SHA of this orchestration repo itself at the time of the run.

driver_script.description: Source path of the driver script staged into the scenario folder for this run -- relative to the run_set directory if a custom driver_script was declared, or relative to the TDM submodule root (e.g. 'Scenarios/_default/_HailMary_1Subfolder.s') if the framework's default was used. Absent only for execution_mode 'manual', where no staging occurred.

start_at_label.description: STEPn/STEPn_nn label this attempt's driver script was resumed from (its RESUME POINT GOTO target was rewritten to this value), if the scenario declared start_at_label and/or `run-scenario --start-at` was passed. Absent for a normal full run.

start_at_override.description: True if start_at_label came from `run-scenario --start-at` for this one attempt, overriding (or supplying, if absent) the scenario's own declared start_at_label. False if it came from the scenario YAML itself. Present only alongside start_at_label.

general_parameters.description: Present only when this run declared general_parameter_overrides (run_set and/or scenario level, merged). Records the GeneralParameters.block overrides applied via the per-run override file/extra READ FILE described in src/tdmruns/general_parameters.py -- a separate mechanism from control_center's overrides above.

voyager_exe.description: Absolute path to the Cube Voyager executable used for this attempt -- resolved from the scenario's/run set's voyager_exe override, or config/local.yaml's machine-wide Voyager_EXE default if neither declares one. Recorded for reproducibility, since a TDM version can require a specific Cube Voyager install.

status_source.description: How run status was decided. "model_log" means the TDM's own _Log\_RunTime.txt completion report was found and used (preferred -- Voyager's process exit code alone has been observed to disagree with what the model itself reports). "exit_code" means no recognizable log entry was found yet, so the batch entry point's exit code was used instead, as before. Absent for execution_mode "manual", where no execution happened here at all.

model_log.description: Parsed from the TDM's own _Log\_RunTime.txt (see status_source). Absent when that file/entry wasn't found.

crashed_step.description: The @ModelStep@ value Cube was on when ONRUNERRORGOTO fired, if outcome is "crashed".

started_at.description: Raw Cube-formatted timestamp ('yyyy-mm-dd,  hh:nn:ss'), not reformatted.

exit_code_mismatch.description: True if the model log's outcome and Voyager's exit code disagreed (e.g. a clean completion with a non-zero exit code) -- status_source "model_log" won the disagreement.

seeded_from.description: Identifies the prior run whose raw scenario folder was copied into this one before Control Center rendering, when this scenario declared start_from_copy. Absent when the scenario started from an empty folder.

committed.description: False when this file exceeded outputs.max_file_size_mb -- it was still written to repo_path locally (e.g. for rendering reports on this machine) but is listed in its outputs/ folder's auto-generated .gitignore and was never committed to the repo.

retired.description: True once `tdmruns purge-run-set-outputs` has deleted this run's curated output files. The curated[] manifest (paths/sizes/checksums) is left in place as a permanent record of what once existed; repo_path no longer resolves to a file on disk.

retired_at.description: When this run's outputs were purged, if ever.
